scripts.db:migrate: npm exec --workspace server -- prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:push: npm exec --workspace server -- prisma db push
scripts.bombadil: CHROME=bombadil/chrome-muted.sh bombadil browser test --headless --time-limit 2m --exit-on-violation --output-path bombadil-output --output-path-overwrite http://localhost:3000 bombadil/spec.ts
scripts.bombadil:watch: CHROME=bombadil/chrome-muted.sh bombadil browser test --time-limit 5m --output-path bombadil-output --output-path-overwrite http://localhost:3000 bombadil/spec.ts
